title: DR1 lets a user reuse an address already given for another role with one click on the consignment addresses page; the frontend makes them search the address book again for every role.

finding.frontend: Every role on the Consignment addresses page offers exactly one action, Add, which opens that role's address picker. There is no way to say that the consignor is the same as the place of origin, or that the importer or the place of destination is the same as the consignee: the user goes to the picker and finds the same address in the list again. The hub builds one action per row from a single template, so no row can offer a second one (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/controller.js:32-46).
finding.prototype: Once an earlier role is filled, DR1 adds a second action to the roles that can borrow from it, beside the Add link. Consignor gains Same as place of origin; Importer and Place of destination each gain Same as consignee (app/views/roles-and-addresses.html:84-101). Pressing one copies the name, address lines and country straight into that role and returns to the page with the address shown. The shortcut appears only while the source role is filled and the target is not, so it never offers a copy there is nothing to copy from and never sits beside an address that has already been chosen.
finding.difference: Give the consignor, importer and place-of-destination rows a second action that copies the already-chosen address into that role and returns to the Consignment addresses page. The frontend already holds each chosen party in the notification's answers, so the copy is a state write and needs no new lookup. Which role borrows from which is fixed by DR1: consignor from place of origin, importer and place of destination from consignee. The action must disappear once the target role has an address of its own, otherwise it overwrites a deliberate choice.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a control anywhere in the frontend that copies one role's address into another — a Same as link on the consignment addresses page, or a party page that arrives with the earlier role's address already selected.
finding.verification: Read the fe-addresses-hub DOM and screenshot, all three DR1 roles-and-addresses DOMs and the partial-state screenshot, the frontend hub controller whole and app/views/roles-and-addresses.html at the cited lines; ran the falsifier across the hub controller and all five party pickers. It does not fire — every hub row is built by one `hubRow` helper whose `actions.items` array holds exactly one entry, and no picker capture arrives with a radio pre-selected. DR1's partial-state capture shows all three shortcuts at once, as submit buttons styled as links with actions same-as-place-of-origin:consignor-or-exporter, same-as-consignee:importer and same-as-consignee:place-of-destination, and the elif chain in the view confirms they are suppressed once the target role is filled. CORRECT.

relatedTo.why: both change how a filled role is presented on the consignment addresses page, and both land in the same row template
